Mysuru Dasara Celebrations Begin with Cultural and Heritage Focus

The Mysuru Dasara festival commenced with Chief Minister D.K. Shivakumar highlighting the event's role in showcasing India's culture and heritage. He stated that the 11-day celebrations would present a glimpse of the nation's traditions to a global audience, noting how the Wadiyar dynasty had transformed Mysuru into a hub for art and culture. The inauguration's message emphasized humanity and peace, while Navaratri festivities also began at the Basar temple.
